code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    line = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg)
    line_color = grid[line][0]
    obj = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg and not (r == line and v == line_color)]
    top = min(r for r, c, v in obj); bottom = max(r for r, c, v in obj)
    if bottom < line:
        new_top = line - 1 - (bottom - top)
        marker = new_top - 1
    else:
        new_top = line + 1
        marker = new_top + (bottom - top) + 1
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    out[line] = grid[line][:]
    for r, c, v in obj:
        out[new_top + (r - top)][c] = v
    if 0 <= marker < h:
        out[marker] = [8] * w
    return out
'''

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    line = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg)
    line_color = grid[line][0]
    obj = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg and not (r == line and v == line_color)]
    top = min(r for r, c, v in obj); bottom = max(r for r, c, v in obj)
    if bottom < line:
        new_top = line - 1 - (bottom - top)
        marker = new_top - 1
    else:
        new_top = line + 1
        marker = new_top + (bottom - top) + 1
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    out[line] = grid[line][:]
    for r, c, v in obj:
        out[new_top + (r - top)][c] = v
    if 0 <= marker < h:
        out[marker] = [8] * w
    return out
